segments_witness.description: A path both segment patterns match, or null. Input: `a`, `b` (segment arrays). `opts` is optional and holds the matching options `dot`, `caseInsensitive` and `globstarMatchesZero`. Expect: the witness as a segment array, or null. The witness comes from a breadth-first search: segments are tried in pattern order, and among equal-length paths the first found wins, so an implementation copies that order.

cases.name: witness: overlapping patterns yield a common segmented path
witness: disjoint patterns yield null

fs_files_in_scope.description: The files on disk that a pattern set matches. Input: `tree` (relative file paths, created empty under a new temp directory), optionally `symlinks` (`{ link: target }`, created after the tree, the target written as given), `unreadable` (directories of the tree set to mode 000), `cwd` (the directory to run in, relative to the temp directory; it may be missing or a file; default the temp directory), `cwdRelative` (pass `cwd` relative to the process working directory), `patterns` (Patterns), and `opts` with `dot`, `caseInsensitive`, `globstarMatchesZero`, `ignore` (string array), `onlyFiles` (boolean, default true) and `absolute` (boolean). Expect: the paths, `/`-separated and relative to the temp directory, sorted by code point. With `opts.absolute` the call returns absolute paths, and each must be the temp directory joined with the expected relative path. A case with `unreadable` cannot run as root, where mode 000 does not stop a read.
